# MatchCalender

> MatchCalender (https://matchcalender.com) generates live, always-updated calendar
> subscription links for sports fixtures. A fan picks a league or team, gets a standard
> iCal feed URL, and every fixture, including reschedules and playoff rounds, syncs
> automatically into Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook. Free, no account required.

## What it is

MatchCalender is a calendar subscription service, not a one-time export and not a
schedule-browsing site. The distinction matters: a one-time export goes stale the moment
a match is rescheduled, whereas a subscribed iCal feed is re-fetched by the calendar app
and stays correct on its own. Subscribe once, and the calendar stays current.

- Price: free, no charge for any feature
- Account required: no
- Output format: standard iCal (.ics) subscription feed
- Compatible with: Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook, any iCal-capable client
- Covers: football, hockey, basketball, motorsport
- Kickoff times: always shown in the visitor's own timezone, detected from the browser

## Timezones

Kickoff times are never shown in a fixed league timezone that the reader has to convert.
On the website, times are rendered in whatever timezone the browser reports, so a Premier
League fixture reads as local time to a visitor in Stockholm and to a visitor in New York
without either of them changing a setting.

The calendar feed handles this the same way by a different route: events are published as
UTC timestamps, and the subscribing calendar app converts them to the device's current
timezone. The practical effect is that a synced fixture shows the correct local time on
every device, and it stays correct if the user travels across timezones or when daylight
saving shifts.

## Common questions this site answers

- How do I add a team's fixtures to my Google Calendar automatically?
- How do I subscribe to a league schedule in Apple Calendar?
- How do I keep a sports calendar updated when matches get rescheduled?
- Where can I get an iCal feed for a football or hockey league?
- Are kickoff times shown in my own timezone, or do I have to convert them?
- Will match times still be right if I travel to another timezone?

## League calendars

### Football

- [Premier League](https://matchcalender.com/premier-league): The complete Premier League schedule. Subscribe once and every fixture and kickoff time syncs straight to your calendar.
- [Champions League](https://matchcalender.com/champions-league): Every UEFA Champions League fixture. Subscribe once and the whole schedule stays synced in your calendar.
- [Europa League](https://matchcalender.com/europa-league): Every UEFA Europa League fixture. Subscribe once and the whole schedule stays synced in your calendar.
- [Conference League](https://matchcalender.com/conference-league): Every UEFA Conference League fixture. Subscribe once and the whole schedule stays synced in your calendar.
- [FA Cup](https://matchcalender.com/fa-cup): Every FA Cup round. Subscribe once and each new draw syncs straight to your calendar as it's announced.
- [EFL Cup](https://matchcalender.com/efl-cup): Every EFL Cup (Carabao Cup) round. Subscribe once and each new draw syncs straight to your calendar.
- [Allsvenskan](https://matchcalender.com/allsvenskan): The complete Allsvenskan schedule. Subscribe once and every match syncs straight to your calendar.
- [FIFA World Cup 2026](https://matchcalender.com/world-cup-2026): Every FIFA World Cup 2026 match. Subscribe once and the full tournament schedule stays synced in your calendar.

### Hockey

- [SDHL](https://matchcalender.com/sdhl): The complete SDHL schedule. Subscribe once and every game syncs straight to your calendar.
- [IIHF World Championship](https://matchcalender.com/iihf-world-championship): Every IIHF World Championship game. Subscribe once and the full tournament schedule stays synced in your calendar.

### Basketball

- [SBL Herrar](https://matchcalender.com/sbl-herrar): The complete SBL Herrar schedule. Subscribe once and every game syncs straight to your calendar.
- [SBL Damer](https://matchcalender.com/sbl-damer): The complete SBL Damer schedule. Subscribe once and every game syncs straight to your calendar.

### Motorsport

- [F1](https://matchcalender.com/f1): The complete Formula 1 season. Subscribe once and every session start time syncs straight to your calendar.
